findings.evidence: We collect personally identifiable information about you when you specifically and knowingly provide such information voluntarily on the Site, including, but not limited to, during the following interactions: (1) when you register on the Site and when you later log-on with your user name and password; (2) when you sign-up to subscribe to a service, a newsletter, or ask to be added to our mailing lists for other products or services; (3) when you place an order for products or services; (4) when you participate in a promotional offer; (5) when you provide feedback in an online survey; (6) when you submit other content and suggestions.
findings.rationale: The policy does not explicitly state the collection of demographic data, but mentions collecting non-personally identifiable information which includes IP addresses and anonymous statistical data.

findings.evidence: In each of the instances above, we typically ask for some or all of the following information: your full name, e-mail address, phone number, physical mailing address, the type of business you are in, product preference information, any applicable identification number or password that we may require, as well as other similar information that is needed to register or subscribe you to services or offers.
findings.rationale: The policy does not specify any purpose for collecting user profiles, and the quote only describes the types of information collected.
